name: todo-webapp

dependencies.name: todo-api
dependencies.description: Creates, lists, and completes the signed-in user's todos.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Signs the user in through Thunder and carries the token to todo-api.

description: Single-page React app where a signed-in user manages their own private todo list: create a todo, view the list, and mark items complete or reopen them. Does not store any data itself — all persistence goes through todo-api.
